content: {"reasoning":"The denial is CO-197 for missing prior authorization. This payer does not offer retroactive authorization or peer-to-peer review, and an appeal with medical necessity was already attempted and failed to resolve. No auth path remains, so the claim is not recoverable from the payer. Since the auth was missing at time of service (a provider error), this is typically not billable to the patient and should be written off.","action":"write_off"}
